description: Two-phase email ingestion via Mac Bridge with JWD hybrid: JWD fetches emails and stages them to Sources/email/; email-fetch classifies and posts Hub review card; email-commit (triggered by Hub action button) writes vault entries. JWD also picks up reply drafts from _EmailOutbox/ for Outlook.

userStories.title: Create JWD email skill prompt files
userStories.description: As a user, I need two prompt files I can paste into Joule Work Desktop so JWD can stage emails into the vault and later pick up reply drafts for sending — no installation required.
acceptanceCriteria: _Ingest/JWD-EMAIL-FETCH.md created in the Mitchell vault with instructions for JWD to: read emails since last-run.json timestamp (default 7 days), format each as a clean .md file with YAML frontmatter (from, to, subject, date, message_id), write to Sources/email/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-{subject-slug}.md

_Ingest/JWD-EMAIL-OUTBOX.md created in the Mitchell vault with instructions for JWD to: read all .md files from _Ingest/_EmailOutbox/, parse frontmatter (to, cc, subject, in_reply_to), create Outlook draft for each, move processed files to _Ingest/_EmailOutbox/sent/
Both files include the Mitchell vault absolute path so JWD knows where to read/write
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: These are prompts for the user to paste into JWD — not code. JWD handles all Outlook I/O; Claude handles vault intelligence.

A migration file is created in db/migrations/ and applied to the SQLite database

userStories.title: Hub ingest API — persist card action fields

userStories.title: Hub cards action API endpoint
userStories.description: As the Hub frontend, I need an endpoint to call when the user clicks 'Approve and ingest' so it creates the follow-up job automatically.

Reads action_job_type, action_job_title, action_job_input from the card row by id
Returns 400 { error: 'No action configured for this card' } if action_job_type is null

Inserts a new job row with the card's action_job_type, action_job_title, and input_json (parsed from action_job_input)
Returns 201 { job_id: N }

userStories.title: Hub frontend — action button on cards
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click 'Approve and ingest' directly on the preview card so the commit job starts without navigating to the jobs page.
acceptanceCriteria: In app/_components/HubClient.tsx, when a card has both actionLabel and action_job_type: render a <button> instead of the current static hint text div

Button click POSTs to /api/cards/{id}/action
During POST: button is disabled and shows a loading indicator

Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create _Ingest/EMAIL-FETCH.md pipeline script
userStories.description: As the Mac Bridge, I need a Claude prompt script that reads staged email files from Sources/email/, classifies them, and posts a Hub review card — without writing anything to the vault yet.
acceptanceCriteria: _Ingest/EMAIL-FETCH.md created in the Mitchell vault

Phase 0: reads _Ingest/_IngestQueue/last-run.json; if absent defaults to 7 days ago; globs all .md files in Sources/email/ and filters to those with a date frontmatter field newer than the last-run timestamp
Phase 0 edge case: if zero files found, posts an information card to Hub ('Inbox clear — nothing staged since {date}') and exits without writing any files
Phase 1: classifies each email as crm | internal-six | internal-meeting | reference-story | unknown using the same rules as EMAIL.md Phase 1
Phase 2: scores each email High | Medium | Low using the same rules as EMAIL.md Phase 2
Phase 3: extracts actions, decisions, risks, competitive mentions, kb_candidate flag using the same rules as EMAIL.md Phase 3

Phase 4: writes _Ingest/_IngestQueue/email-batch-{YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss}.json containing an array of email objects each with: source_file (path to .md in Sources/email/), from, subject, date, classification, importance, client (if crm), body_excerpt, actions, decisions, risks, competitive, kb_candidate

Phase 5: POSTs a preview action card to Hub /api/ingest with action_label 'Approve and ingest', action_job_type 'email-commit', action_job_title 'Ingest email batch {date}', action_job_input { path: '_Ingest/_IngestQueue/email-batch-{timestamp}.json' }, and a body summarising CRM count, internal count, unknown count, total actions extracted, and competitive mentions
No vault files outside _Ingest/_IngestQueue/ are created or modified
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reads from Sources/email/ staged by JWD. No Outlook MCP required.

userStories.title: Create _Ingest/EMAIL-COMMIT.md pipeline script
userStories.description: As the Mac Bridge, I need a Claude prompt script that reads a staged batch file, writes all vault entries, stages reply drafts for JWD pickup, and rolls back on error.
acceptanceCriteria: _Ingest/EMAIL-COMMIT.md created in the Mitchell vault
Phase 1: reads the batch JSON from the path passed as prefix by the bridge

Phase 2: tracks every vault file created in an in-memory list before writing; on any write failure deletes all files created in this run, posts a warning card to Hub with what succeeded and what failed, then exits without updating last-run.json

Phase 2 success path: writes all vault entries per EMAIL.md Phase 5 rules — meeting stubs in Clients/{client}/meetings/, client hub intelligence blocks in Clients/{client}/{client}.md, SIX updates in Internal/SIX-Updates/, internal meeting notes in Internal/meetings/, task inbox in Personal/Tasks/email-tasks-{date}.md, reference story notes in solution reference folders

Phase 3: for each email in the batch that has extracted actions requiring a reply, writes a draft .md file to _Ingest/_EmailOutbox/{date}-reply-{slug}.md with frontmatter: to, subject, in_reply_to (source filename), and a draft body
Phase 4: moves all processed source .md files from Sources/email/ to Sources/email/processed/
Phase 5: deletes the batch file from _Ingest/_IngestQueue/
Phase 6: writes current ISO timestamp to _Ingest/_IngestQueue/last-run.json
Phase 7: calls _Ingest/REPORT.md with completion summary
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No Outlook MCP required. Reply drafts go to _EmailOutbox/ for JWD to pick up and create as Outlook drafts.

userStories.title: EMAIL.md — add redirect warning callout
userStories.description: As a user opening EMAIL.md in an interactive session, I want a clear warning that a better automated pipeline exists so I don't accidentally use the old flow.
acceptanceCriteria: A prominent callout block is added at the very top of _Ingest/EMAIL.md before any pipeline instructions
Callout states that EMAIL-FETCH.md is the preferred pipeline for automated and Mac Bridge use
Callout explicitly asks the user to confirm they intend to use the manual Sources/email/ flow before proceeding
All existing pipeline instructions below the callout are unchanged
Typecheck passes
